# Daybook — Implementation Outline & Design Notes

## Overview

- **Source**: ColorLib Calendar V14 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/calendar-14/`)
- **App Name**: `daybook`
- **Package**: `@free-react-templates/daybook`

## Structure & Section Order

1. **Header / Navbar**: Title, navigation links (Home, Calendar, Events, Settings), search toggle.
2. **Hero / Calendar Main Area**: Interactive month/year header, day headers (Sun-Sat), date cells with event indicators and selection state.
3. **Sidebar / Event Details**: Selected date overview, scheduled events list, and "Add Event" modal/form trigger.
4. **Footer**: Clean modern footer with copyright and mandatory link to `https://www.componentdock.com/` ("Component Dock").

## Fidelity Notes

- Clean modern calendar layout replicating the clean UI of Calendar V14.
- Neutral slate background with indigo/violet accent color for active dates and primary actions.
- Fully interactive date clicking, month cycling, and mock event addition.
